title: 第21章 去路第22章 远行
content_zh:
就这样恍恍惚惚不知所措的回到李莲花的住处，方多病才发现桌上留了一张纸条，方才自己一心找人，并未注意，又不由得在心内暗笑：“真是粗心，早上还在一起，怎么会是一场梦？”
方多病按照纸条所说，找到后山的瀑布，李莲花正坐在潭边的巨石上打坐，那巨石也不知是天生地长还是人为雕琢，竟像一张石床一般卧在潭边，方多病提起一口真气，飘然落在李莲花身侧，见他专心打坐也不好打扰，只好盘腿托腮坐在他身边，看他打坐。
李莲花在他过来之时已然知道，一时起了捉弄他的心，也不说话只等少年开口。
不知过了多久，方多病心急如焚，他不敢想象，若是李莲花又像之前那样怕连累方家，自行离去自己又该如何是好，只嘴里呐呐自语叫着他的名字：“李莲花~”
“嗯？”
漫不经心的声音在方多病耳边响起，此时少年再也忍耐不住，这磨人的声音，到底他想如何，也不给个痛快，想到此处，他猛地站起身形，弯下腰凑近李莲花的脸，也不出声就这样盯着面前人的脸看，看他何时睁眼。
“哈哈，小宝！”李莲花一把将方多病抱入怀中，与他胸腹贴着胸腹，让他环坐在自己怀中，只笑着说：“我的小宝，你怎么这样可爱，生气也不敢叫我知道。”
方多病倒是被他吓了一跳，只挪了挪身子让自己坐稳些，抬头看他脸色，才知道被人捉弄，心下轻松，却当场闹了个大红脸，这人怎么这样大胆！
“小宝，你在担心什么？”李莲花越看怀中的人越觉得自己捡到宝了，“我今生已经认定你了，只要你不愿意，管它公主还是皇帝，这些人有什么可怕？”
方多病此时才猛然惊觉，他是李莲花，可他先是李相夷，李相夷想要的东西天下没有人能阻止。这反叫让自己不知道该如何应对了，他想过李莲花会临阵脱逃，想过他又要抛下自己，还想与他算账，没想到他倒是比自己还坚决。
“小宝，我只问你，你当真不愿娶公主吗？”
“自是不愿！”方多病心中暗想，要是自己愿意，怎么还会认识你李莲花，早就是皇帝老儿的乘龙快婿了。
“你不愿意，天下就没人可以强迫你，”那调笑的声音又起，“或是你娶了公主，做了驸马，只与我夜夜在一起，我也是愿意陪着你的！”
“胡说什么？”少年的脸更红了，还夜夜一起，“公主是个好姑娘。”
“你见过公主？”李莲花皱起了眉头，二人若未见过面，那还好说，但听小宝的语气，二人似是还有交往。
“嗯，咱们一起遇见过。”方多病想起在女宅时的过往，可惜这人也忘记了。
“那公主漂亮吗？”
“……”方多病一时沉默，片刻趴在身下人耳边说，“不如卿多矣！”
“哈哈，小宝，我的小宝！”
李莲花笑着又去吻怀中少年的唇，只要他的心在自己身上，别的都不是问题。

“李莲花，你可别再抛下我了。”少年任他吻着，嘴里含含糊糊的也还是说出了心中最担忧的事。
以前不知道让这人伤了多少次心？李莲花叹了一口气，只好加深这个吻，他也不知道自己现在做什么才会让怀里的人真正相信自己。
等这一吻结束，方多病不仅脸通红，觉得小腹坠胀，他不知该如何解决，只能趴在李莲花耳边轻声说，“小花，我难受。”
“哪里难受？”李莲花听他如此说，声音也好似虚弱了许多，还以为他近日辛劳，难免有些病症。
方多病牵起他的手，直往自己下腹探去。
“乖~，用扬州慢。”李莲花松了一口气，少年人定力不足也是有的。
“不要~”方多病只在李莲花耳边小声哼哼，明明两个人已经心意相通，为何还要在意这些小节，江湖儿女就是要洒脱些。
李莲花无奈，顺着少年的心，只跟着他的手行动。
方多病感受着那带着剑茧的手，那手却比想象中的柔软许多。
不多时，又被人又擒住了嘴唇，手也被人拉入怀中，暧昧的声音响起，“小宝，现在还不是时候。”
哎，方多病在心中叹气，刚还说李相夷无往不利，此时怎地如此教条，非要家中长辈同意才可。
“我能做得了自己的主！”
“知道，可是不行，我要光明正大的与你一起。”
好，既然如此，方多并不客气的将手抚上心上人的背，“既然你要做柳下惠，本少爷倒要看看你能忍到什么时候？”
李莲花只是轻笑着任少年动作，他也不去阻止，只是还是不肯放过他的唇。
李相夷的心上人，值得这天下最好的东西，一纸承诺不过是根本，李莲花只要做的比李相夷更好，当然要给心上人天下最好的东西，光明正大的给。
当晚，芩婆又拉着李莲花，给他细细诊了一回脉，发现他右手右脚经脉还有些不通，一定要他留在云隐山调理好了才叫他出门，方多病自是希望等他好全了再出门，可是李莲花却急着出门游历，一是想要找回丢失的记忆，二是终身大事早日定下早日心安。
李相夷一直都是这样的性子，事情出了，立刻就要看到结果。
“相夷，不是师娘说你，你的性子怎么还和十一年前一样啊？”芩婆有些疑惑，“你上次回来之时，我看你稳重多了，怎么如今毒解了却急躁起来？”
“可能是这毒解了，徒弟心就放宽了吧，确实是有些少年心性了。”李莲花还是不想让师娘担心，“我这右腿右手现在也没有什么大问题了，只是偶尔还有些麻痹而已，师娘不要担心。”

“不行，这次不能答应你，上次师娘答应你，结果怎样？你自己知道！”
这件事情确实是李莲花自己心虚，这次也只好乖乖留下，又在云隐山呆了十日，芩婆方才安心。
content_en:
Just like this, he returned to Li Lianhua's residence in a daze and was confused. Only then did Fang Duobing find a note left on the table. He had just been looking for someone and didn't notice it. He couldn't help but chuckle in his heart: "It's so careless. We were still together in the morning. How could it be a dream?"
Fang Duobing followed what the note said and found the waterfall in the back mountain. Li Lianhua was sitting on a huge stone meditating by the pool. Whether it was naturally long or man-made, it was lying on the edge of the pool like a stone bed. Fang Duobing took a breath of Qi and floated down beside Li Lianhua. Seeing that he was concentrating on meditating, he didn't want to disturb him, so he had to sit with his legs crossed and his chin on his side to watch him meditate.
Li Lianhua already knew when he came over, and for a moment she wanted to tease him. She didn't say anything and only waited for the young man to speak.
I don't know how much time passed, but Fang Duobing was so anxious that he couldn't imagine what he would do if Li Lianhua left on her own because she was afraid of harming the Fang family as before. She just muttered his name to herself: "Li Lianhua~"
"Huh?"
A careless voice rang in Fang Duobing's ears. At this moment, the young man couldn't bear it anymore. He didn't want to be happy with this irritating voice. Thinking of this, he stood up suddenly, bent down and got close to Li Lianhua's face. He stared at the face of the person in front of him without making a sound, to see when he would open his eyes.
"Haha, little treasure!" Li Lianhua hugged Fang Duobing into his arms, held him chest and abdomen, let him sit in her arms, and said with a smile: "My little treasure, why are you so cute, and you don't dare to let me know when you are angry."
Fang Duobing was startled by him. He only moved his body to sit more stable. He looked up at his face and realized that he was being teased. He felt relieved, but he made a big blush on the spot. How could this man be so bold!
"Xiaobao, what are you worried about?" The more Li Lianhua looked at the person in her arms, the more she felt that she had found a treasure. "I have already recognized you in this life. As long as you don't want to, it doesn't matter whether you are a princess or an emperor. What are these people to be afraid of?"
Fang Duobing suddenly realized at this moment that he was Li Lianhua, but he was Li Xiangyi first, and no one in the world could stop what Li Xiangyi wanted. This made him don't know how to deal with it. He thought that Li Lianhua would run away, thought that he would abandon him again, and wanted to settle accounts with him, but he didn't expect that he would be more determined than him.
"Xiaobao, I just want to ask you, are you really unwilling to marry the princess?"
"Of course I don't want to!" Fang Duobing thought to himself, if he was willing, how could he still get to know you, Li Lianhua, who has long been the emperor's son-in-law.
"If you don't want to, no one in the world can force you," the teasing voice said again, "Or if you marry a princess, become a consort, and only spend time with me every night, I will also be willing to accompany you!"
"What nonsense are you talking about?" The boy's face turned even redder, and he continued to say, "The princess is a good girl."
"Have you met the princess?" Li Lianhua frowned. If the two of them had never met, it would be easy to say, but judging from Xiaobao's tone, they seemed to be in a relationship.
"Well, we met together." Fang Duobing thought of the past when he was at the girl's house, but it was a pity that this person also forgot about it.
"Is the princess beautiful?"
"..." Fang Duobing was silent for a moment, then he leaned into the ear of the person below him and said, "I'm not as good as Qing Duo!"
"Haha, little treasure, my little treasure!"
Li Lianhua smiled and kissed the boy in her arms on the lips again. As long as his heart was with her, nothing else mattered.
"Li Lianhua, please don't abandon me again." The young man let him kiss him and mumbled what was most worrying in his heart.
I don’t know how many times I’ve let this person break my heart before? Li Lianhua sighed and had no choice but to deepen the kiss. He didn't know what he should do now to make the person in his arms truly believe in him.
When the kiss ended, Fang Duobing's face turned red and he felt his lower abdomen was bloated. He didn't know how to solve the problem, so he could only lie down next to Li Lianhua's ear and whisper, "LittleFlower, I feel bad. "
"Where do you feel uncomfortable? "When Li Lianhua heard what he said, her voice seemed to be much weaker. She thought that he was inevitably suffering from some illness due to his hard work recently.
Fang Duobing took his hand and went straight to his lower abdomen.
"Be good~, use Yangzhou slowly. "Li Lianhua breathed a sigh of relief. It is common for young people to lack concentration.
"No~" Fang Duobing just whispered in Li Lianhua's ear. It was obvious that the two of them already had the same mind, so why should they care about these little details? People in the world should be free and easy.
Li Lianhua had no choice but to follow the young man's heart and only follow his hands.
Fang Duobing felt the hand with the sword cocoon, but it was much softer than he imagined.
Not long after, someone captured his lips again, his hand was pulled into his arms, and an ambiguous voice sounded, "Xiaobao, now is not the time. "
Alas, Fang Duobing sighed in his heart. He just said that Li Xiangyi was always invincible. How could he be so dogmatic now? He had to agree with the elders in the family.
"I can be my own master! "
"I know, but no, I want to be with you openly. "
Okay, in that case, Fang Duo put his hand on his sweetheart's back unceremoniously, "Since you want to be Liu Xiahui, I want to see how long you can endure it? "
Li Lianhua just chuckled and let the boy do whatever he wanted. He didn't try to stop her, but still refused to let go of his lips.
Li Xiangyi's sweetheart deserves the best in the world, and a promise is just the foundation. As long as Li Lianhua does better than Li Xiangyi, of course he will give his sweetheart the best in the world, and give it openly and honestly.
That night, Qin Po took Li Lianhua again and examined his pulse carefully. She found that the meridians in his right hand and right foot were still somewhat blocked, and she had to stay in Yunyin Mountain for recuperation before sending him out. Fang Duobing naturally hoped to wait until he was well before going out, but Li Lianhua was eager to go out and travel. Firstly, she wanted to retrieve her lost memories, and secondly, she wanted to settle down her life-long events as soon as possible.
Li Xiangyi has always had this kind of temperament. When something happens, he will see the result immediately.
"Xiangyi, it's not that the master's wife said something about you, why are your temper still the same as it was eleven years ago? "Qin Po was a little confused, "When you came back last time, I thought you were much more stable. Why are you so irritable now that the poison has been removed? "
"Maybe it's because the poison has been cured and the apprentice has relaxed his mind. He does have a young mind. "Li Lianhua still didn't want to worry Mistress, "There's no big problem with my right leg and right hand now. It's just that I still have some numbness occasionally. Don't worry, Master. "
"No, I can't promise you this time. The last time my wife promised you, what happened? You know it yourself! "
Li Lianhua was indeed guilty of this matter, so she had no choice but to stay and stayed in Yunyin Mountain for another ten days before Qinpo felt at ease.
